title: How to Shop for Free Online
note: Foundational analysis of trust and state mismatches between merchants and third-party cashiers. Historical findings do not establish current prevalence.

title: Attack Patterns for Black-Box Security Testing
note: Pattern-based testing of multi-party web applications. A methodological starting point for replay and protocol-state cases.

title: Alipay-PIBench
note: Most direct related work: nine product projects and 18 coding-agent integration tasks. Differentiate through cross-provider assurance and evidence coverage.

title: Can AI agents build real Stripe integrations?
note: Industry benchmark of coding agents on full-stack Stripe integrations. Measures whether integrations work; security evaluation isn't described.

title: BaxBench: Can LLMs Generate Correct and Secure Backends?
note: Closest method: generated backends attacked with real exploits. Generic backends, not payment-specific money or state outcomes.

title: Protocol-Level Attacks on Agentic Commerce Platforms
note: Adjacent work on agentic payment protocols and AIP-Bench. Keep distinct from ordinary merchant checkout integrations.

title: Fulfillment and webhooks
note: Guidance for reliable payment completion, event verification and repeat delivery.

title: Validate webhook notifications
note: Provider-specific signature inputs. Stripe and Square signatures are not interchangeable.

title: SAQ A script eligibility (FAQ 1588)
note: Distinguishes embedded payment forms from redirects for one eligibility criterion. Not a general PCI exemption.

title: CVSS v4.0
note: For severity of individual validated findings. Keep separate from integration-wide assurance.
